meta.source: HESEOS Product Brochure 2026–27 (68 pages, pdf/updated brochure 2026-27 (2).pdf)
meta.about: The full HESEOS product catalogue, until the admin panel replaces this file. Categories hold subcategories; subcategories hold product families; each family lists its selectable options and the configurations named in the brochure. Listing cards use illustrative generated studio renders; detail galleries retain brochure and model-specific images. `review` notes on any record are internal and never rendered.
meta.disclaimer: Product pictures may differ from the actual product. Specifications are taken from the HESEOS 2026–27 brochure; configurations and finishes are confirmed with every quote.

faqs.q: How do I get a price?
faqs.a: Choose the configuration you need on any product page and select Request a quote. Our team replies with pricing, availability and lead times for your project.

faqs.q: Are the product pictures exact?
faqs.a: Pictures are illustrative and may differ from the actual product. Ask for a demo to see the hardware in person.

faqs.q: Does HESEOS work with my voice assistant?
faqs.a: The HESEOS app works with Google Home, Amazon Alexa and Apple Siri.

categories.name: Smart Switches & Control
categories.description: Touch panels, retrofit modules, modular switches, premium glass switches and screen control panels. Control lights, fans and appliances by touch, from the HESEOS app or with your voice.

categories.name: Home Automation Devices
categories.tagline: Make the home you have smart.
categories.description: Smart plugs, IR blasters, energy meters and curtain motors that bring your existing appliances, remotes and windows into the HESEOS app.

categories.name: Smart Security
categories.tagline: Every door. Every alert. In your pocket.
categories.description: Smart door locks, video door phones and doorbells, and security sensors that keep watch and tell you the moment something happens.

categories.name: Smart Lighting
categories.description: Smart COB downlights and motion-sensing tubelights, in IoT and non-IoT versions, with dimming and single-colour or CCT light.

categories.name: Smart Fans
categories.description: HESEOS Elegance smart BLDC fans in six design collections, with remote, app and voice control.

subcategories.name: Touch Panels
subcategories.description: HESEOS Touch Panels replace the entire traditional switchboard with a sleek, modern touch interface. Five series, each in 2, 4, 6, 8 and 12 module sizes.

faqs.q: What sizes do touch panels come in?
faqs.a: Every series is listed in 2, 4, 6, 8 and 12 module sizes.

faqs.q: Which series come in colour finishes?
faqs.a: The Edge (TEA) and Bezzel (TPB) series are shown in Rose Gold, Grey, Gold, Chrome and Black. Finish availability can vary by size, so we confirm it with your quote.

faqs.q: Who can buy the K Panel Series?
faqs.a: The K Panel Series (TPK) is offered to builders only.

subcategories.name: Retrofit Modules
subcategories.tagline: Keep your switches. Make them smart.
subcategories.description: Transform your existing appliances into smart devices with Retrofit. Control your lights, fans and other appliances from your phone, in 1 to 6 module versions.

faqs.q: Do I need to replace my switchboard?
faqs.a: No. Retrofit modules are made for the switchboards you already have, so your existing switches stay in place.

faqs.q: How many appliances can one module control?
faqs.a: Modules come in 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 module versions. Tell us the loads on each board and we will recommend the right size.

subcategories.name: Modular Switches
subcategories.description: Modernize your home by replacing traditional switches while keeping your existing plates intact. On/off, fan regulator and dimmer modules.

faqs.q: Will they fit my existing plates?
faqs.a: Yes. Smart Modular Switches replace traditional switch modules while keeping your existing plates intact.

faqs.q: Can I control a fan's speed?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose the Fan Regulator module for fan speed control, or Light On/Off with Dimmer for dimmable lights.

subcategories.name: Premium Glass Touch Switches
subcategories.tagline: Art and technology, at your fingertips.
subcategories.description: Premium switches with distinctive looks and high quality materials that enhance any interior. 1 to 4 switch configurations in brushed, textured, leather and glass collections.

faqs.q: Which collections are available?
faqs.a: Premium Brushed, Premium Textured, Premium Leather and Premium Glass. Collection availability for each switch configuration is confirmed with your quote.

subcategories.name: Screen Control Panels
subcategories.tagline: Your whole home on one screen.
subcategories.description: Control every smart device from one intuitive interface, with a touchscreen, a knob switch and voice commands. In 4, 6 and 8 inch sizes.

faqs.q: What can I control from the screen?
faqs.a: All your HESEOS smart home devices, plus scenes. The panel also shows temperature and weather.

subcategories.name: Smart Plugs
subcategories.description: Convert traditional appliances into connected devices. Switch 16 A appliances like ACs and geysers from your phone and track the energy they use.

faqs.q: Which appliances can I use with it?
faqs.a: The Smart Plug is made for 16 A heavy appliances such as ACs and geysers.

subcategories.name: IR Blasters
subcategories.description: Automate remote-controlled appliances like ACs and TVs from the HESEOS app, without a drawer full of remotes.

faqs.q: How is it powered?
faqs.a: Plug it into any USB outlet, such as a phone charger.

subcategories.name: Energy Meters
subcategories.description: Track and analyze electricity use in real time across multiple locations, with warnings when consumption crosses your thresholds.

faqs.q: Which versions are available?
faqs.a: A Three Phase Energy Meter and a Three Phase DIN Rail Energy Meter.

subcategories.name: Curtain & Blind Motors
subcategories.tagline: Open the day with a touch.
subcategories.description: Quiet, smooth automation for curtains, drapes and roller blinds, in homes and commercial spaces.

faqs.q: Can it be mounted on the wall?
faqs.a: Yes. The curtain motor supports both ceiling and wall installation.

faqs.q: What happens if something blocks the curtain?
faqs.a: The motor stops on blockage.

subcategories.name: Smart Door Locks
subcategories.description: Smart locks for wooden, glass, sliding and screen doors, levers and drawers. Unlock with fingerprint, password, RFID card, app, OTP or face recognition, depending on the model.

faqs.q: Can several family members use the lock?
faqs.a: Yes. Smart door locks store multiple sets of fingerprints, and adding or managing them is easy.

faqs.q: Can I let a guest in when I'm away?
faqs.a: Yes. Generate passwords and share them so guests can get in when you are not at home. You also get access alerts and an attendance record.

faqs.q: What if the battery runs out?
faqs.a: Models with backup power have a USB external power supply interface, so you can still get in during a power outage.

subcategories.name: Video Door Phones & Doorbells
subcategories.description: Monitor your doorstep with HD video: IP and analog video door phones, and a Wi-Fi smart doorbell.

faqs.q: What's the difference between IP and analog?
faqs.a: An IP VDP uses your internet network for high-quality video and audio and integrates with your smart home. An analog VDP shows live visuals of your entrance and is a cost-effective choice for homes, workplaces and residential complexes.

subcategories.name: Security Sensors
subcategories.description: Compact sensors that monitor motion, presence, gas and smoke, and trigger connected devices or alert you in response.

faqs.q: Microwave or PIR motion sensor?
faqs.a: A microwave sensor uses the Doppler effect and can detect movement through glass and thin walls. A PIR sensor detects the heat people and animals give off within its field of view.

faqs.q: How do gas and smoke alerts reach me?
faqs.a: Install the HESEOS app on any iOS or Android device and it pushes a notification to you wherever you are.

subcategories.name: COB Downlights
subcategories.description: Smart COB downlights in Chrome, Roundo and Deep COB designs, from 8 W to 18 W. Available in IoT and non-IoT, single colour and CCT versions.

faqs.q: Which wattages are available?
faqs.a: Each series has 8 W, 12 W and 18 W models.

faqs.q: Can I get a non-smart version?
faqs.a: Yes. Every series is available in IoT and basic non-IoT versions, in single colour or CCT.

faqs.q: What cut-out do I need?
faqs.a: Cut-outs range from 55 mm to 90 mm depending on the model. Each product page lists the cut-out for every model.

subcategories.name: LED Tubelights
subcategories.tagline: On when you arrive. On when the power isn't.
subcategories.description: A motion-sensing, dimmable T8 tubelight with a built-in emergency battery, for offices, corridors, basements and commercial facilities.

faqs.q: How long does the emergency battery last?
faqs.a: It has a 2200 mAh lithium-ion battery. Backup time depends on brightness; ask us for the data sheet.

subcategories.name: Elegance BLDC Fans
subcategories.description: HESEOS Elegance smart BLDC fans use a brushless motor for smooth, noiseless and reliable operation, with lower power consumption than traditional fans.

faqs.q: What is a BLDC fan?
faqs.a: A BLDC (brushless DC) fan uses a brushless motor for smooth, noiseless and reliable operation, with higher durability and lower power consumption than traditional brushed-motor fans.

faqs.q: What warranty do the fans have?
faqs.a: Elegance fans carry a 3 year warranty.

faqs.q: How can I control the fan?
faqs.a: With the smart remote, the HESEOS app, or your voice through Google Home, Amazon Alexa or Apple Siri.
